name: A Dozen USB-C Chargers in the Lab

mentions.name: A Dozen USB-C Chargers in the Lab
mentions.description: This project recreates Ken Shirriff's charger teardown work by examining a dozen modern USB-C chargers, publishing the results as a lab-style article.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on recreating Google engineer Ken Shirriff's work on chargers. His article "A dozen chargers in the lab" is what I'm trying to replicate, but with modern USB C chargers.
